0.5.2.title: A new look for game pages
0.5.2.text: Theatre's game page is a full-screen stage with a drawer. The desktop pane has a fact line, progress bars and tabs.

0.5.2.title: Quick menu and Now playing
0.5.2.text: Start or Guide opens a menu with Resume, Quit game, Sleep, Restart and Shut down. A summary shows when a game closes.

0.5.2.title: Theatre grows up
0.5.2.text: Library sort and filter, Downloads, Discover with news and deals, and a Your week card on Home.

0.5.2.title: Theatre settings and auto-enter
0.5.2.text: Change settings from the couch. Nexus can start in Theatre on a TV, or when a controller is plugged in.

0.5.2.title: Sounds and colour
0.5.2.text: Optional menu sounds, off by default, and a background tinted by the game you're on.

0.5.2.title: Windows fixes
0.5.2.text: Play works right after installing a game from a setup file, and a false permissions warning is gone.

0.5.1.title: Build your own shelves
0.5.1.text: Make a smart shelf from simple rules like play time, store, genre or last played. It fills itself and can sit on Home.

0.5.1.title: Collections with style
0.5.1.text: Give a collection an icon and a colour, put them in your own order, and pin up to three to the top bar.

0.5.1.title: More looks
0.5.1.text: Six new themes including High contrast, four new accents, and one-click Looks in Settings > Appearance.

0.5.1.title: Uninstall from Storage
0.5.1.text: Free space from the Storage page: pick one or several games and uninstall them, with the same save backup choice.

0.5.1.title: Faster and lighter
0.5.1.text: Nexus starts faster, big libraries open almost instantly and use far less memory, and pages you revisit load at once.

0.5.1.title: Small fixes
0.5.1.text: Fewer false save files, readable deal counters in light themes, and a button to accept changed game files.

0.5.0.title: Know the game at a glance
0.5.0.text: Game pages show the studio, year, genres, a short description and how long it takes to beat, with your progress.

0.5.0.title: Smart shelves
0.5.0.text: The Library groups your games into Continue playing, Unfinished, Almost done, top genres and more. Home has a Smart shelf too.

0.5.0.title: Browse by genre
0.5.0.text: Click a genre on a game page to see every game you have in that genre.

0.5.0.title: Release status on Upcoming
0.5.0.text: Upcoming releases show Early access, Delayed, Cancelled, the PC date and Out now.

0.5.0.title: Details for Heroic games
0.5.0.text: Epic, GOG and Amazon games from Heroic get the same game details as Steam games when Game-db is set up.

0.5.0.title: Play time to Game-db
0.5.0.text: Nexus can send your play time to Game-db. It is off by default; Settings says when a token can only read.

0.4.2.title: Pick your news sites
0.4.2.text: Choose which sites News follows, from a list of ten.

0.4.2.title: Game facts on Windows
0.4.2.text: Game pages show facts from PCGamingWiki, Game-db and HowLongToBeat.

0.4.2.title: Clearer game pages
0.4.2.text: Five sections, and every launch option in one place with a single Apply.

0.4.2.title: Richer Home widgets
0.4.2.text: Play time and Achievements on Home show more at a glance.

0.4.2.title: Safer uninstall
0.4.2.text: Uninstall won't remove a game that is running, and can delete its old snapshots too.

0.4.2.title: Safer uninstall
0.4.2.text: Uninstall won't remove a game that is still running.

0.4.2.title: Epic games
0.4.2.text: They start from Play and show as Playing.

0.4.1: Add a game from any other launcher: pick its .exe and it stays where it is.
The Install page has two clear tabs and shows each step of an install.
A shorter game menu: everyday actions on top, the rest in a few groups.
Game art now blends into the game page.
A Settings switch hides the download and torrent features if you don't use them.
Fixed: Start with Windows works again, and Deals uses the full width when it opens.
